title: Control Tower review & evidence ledger
description: Durable record of review findings across the CryptoPulse repositories. Enforced by governance/validate-ledger.mjs (cross-field rules are listed in docs/EVIDENCE_MODEL.md).

file_path.description: Repo-relative path, or a directory for repository-level findings.

commit_sha.description: Commit on which the finding was observed.

verification_method.description: How the current status was established (tests run, review, rationale). Empty only while open.

timestamp.description: UTC time the current status was recorded.

reviewer.description: Who established the current status. Controlled identities (docs/EVIDENCE_MODEL.md §2): Claude = developer, ChatGPT = reviewer, Gemini = planner, Olivier = decision maker. All four post through one GitHub account, so the label is the identity of record.

related_prs.description: Other PRs where the finding was fixed or verified (R5 accepts a verification_url on pr or any of these).

verification_url.description: Link to the review/comment that verified the fix. Required when status is verified.
